subject: chemistry
note: A-level concepts. Each has its own note, never shared with GCSE or IGCSE. Merged by conceptMap.ts. Each A-level spec point is primary in exactly one concept.

concepts.title: Atomic structure and isotopes
concepts.scope: The particles in an atom, atomic and mass numbers, isotopes and why they share chemical properties.

concepts.title: Mass spectrometry and relative atomic mass
concepts.scope: How a mass spectrometer works and how relative isotopic, atomic and molecular masses are found from mass spectra.

concepts.title: Electron configuration and orbitals
concepts.scope: Shells, sub-shells and orbitals, their shapes, and writing electron configurations of atoms and ions up to Z = 36.

concepts.title: Ionisation energies
concepts.scope: First and successive ionisation energies, the factors that affect them and their trends across periods and down groups.

concepts.title: Formulae, equations and the mole
concepts.scope: Writing formulae and balanced full and ionic equations, and the mole, Avogadro constant and molar mass.

concepts.title: Empirical and molecular formulae
concepts.scope: Calculating empirical and molecular formulae, including hydrated salts and water of crystallisation.

concepts.title: Reacting masses, gas volumes and solutions
concepts.scope: Mole calculations with masses, gas volumes and solution concentrations, including limiting reagents.

concepts.title: The ideal gas equation
concepts.scope: Gas pressure, ideal gas assumptions and calculations with pV = nRT, including finding Mr.

concepts.title: Percentage yield and atom economy
concepts.scope: Calculating percentage yield and atom economy and why a high atom economy matters for sustainability.

concepts.title: Acids, neutralisation and titrations
concepts.scope: Common acids and alkalis, strong and weak acids, neutralisation and salts, and acid-base titration calculations.

concepts.title: Ionic bonding
concepts.scope: How ions form, ionic bonding and lattices, ionic radii trends and the evidence for ions.

concepts.title: Covalent and dative covalent bonding
concepts.scope: Shared and dative pairs, dot-and-cross diagrams, expanded octets, and bond length and bond strength.

concepts.title: Shapes of molecules and ions
concepts.scope: Using electron pair repulsion to predict shapes and bond angles with up to six electron pairs.

concepts.title: Sigma and pi bonds and hybridisation
concepts.scope: Orbital overlap forming sigma and pi bonds and sp, sp2 and sp3 hybridisation, with the shapes they give.

concepts.title: Electronegativity and bond polarity
concepts.scope: Electronegativity and its trends, the ionic-covalent continuum, polar bonds and polar molecules.

concepts.title: Intermolecular forces
concepts.scope: London forces, permanent dipole forces and hydrogen bonding, and how they explain boiling points, water's properties and solubility.

concepts.title: Metallic bonding and giant structures
concepts.scope: Metallic bonding and the four structure types, and predicting physical properties from structure and bonding.

concepts.title: Enthalpy changes and standard conditions
concepts.scope: Exothermic and endothermic changes, enthalpy profile diagrams and the standard enthalpy changes.

concepts.title: Calorimetry
concepts.scope: Measuring enthalpy changes in the lab with q = mcΔT and converting to ΔH in kJ per mole.

concepts.title: Hess's law and enthalpy cycles
concepts.scope: Using Hess's law and enthalpy cycles with formation and combustion data to find enthalpy changes indirectly.

concepts.title: Bond enthalpies
concepts.scope: Mean bond enthalpies and calculating enthalpy changes from bonds broken and made.

concepts.title: Born-Haber cycles and lattice enthalpy
concepts.scope: Lattice enthalpy, atomisation and electron affinity, Born-Haber cycles, and how polarisation makes experimental and theoretical lattice energies differ.

concepts.title: Enthalpies of solution and hydration
concepts.scope: Enthalpy of solution and hydration, the cycle linking them to lattice enthalpy, and the effect of ionic charge and radius.

concepts.title: Entropy
concepts.scope: Entropy as dispersal of energy, predicting the sign of entropy changes, and calculating ΔS for a reaction and its surroundings.

concepts.title: Gibbs free energy and feasibility
concepts.scope: ΔG = ΔH − TΔS, how temperature affects feasibility, ΔG and K, and why feasible reactions may not happen.

concepts.title: Collision theory and measuring rates
concepts.scope: Collision theory, activation energy, the effect of concentration and pressure, and working out rates from data and graphs.

concepts.title: The Maxwell-Boltzmann distribution and temperature
concepts.scope: The Boltzmann distribution and how it explains the effect of temperature on rate.

concepts.title: Catalysts
concepts.scope: How catalysts provide a lower activation energy route, homogeneous and heterogeneous catalysts, and their economic and environmental benefits.

concepts.title: Rate equations and orders
concepts.scope: Rate equations, orders of reaction, the rate constant and its units, and finding orders from initial-rate data.

concepts.title: Rate graphs and half-life
concepts.scope: Concentration-time and rate-concentration graphs, half-life of first-order reactions and methods of following a reaction.

concepts.title: Rate-determining step and mechanisms
concepts.scope: Linking the rate equation to the rate-determining step and using it to propose mechanisms, including SN1 and SN2.

concepts.title: The Arrhenius equation
concepts.scope: The effect of temperature on the rate constant and finding activation energy graphically from the Arrhenius equation.

concepts.title: Dynamic equilibrium and Le Chatelier's principle
concepts.scope: Dynamic equilibrium, Le Chatelier's principle and the compromise conditions chosen in industry.

concepts.title: The equilibrium constant Kc
concepts.scope: Writing Kc expressions and calculating Kc and equilibrium amounts, including units.

concepts.title: Partial pressures and Kp
concepts.scope: Mole fractions, partial pressures and writing and calculating Kp for gaseous and heterogeneous equilibria.

concepts.title: What changes an equilibrium constant
concepts.scope: Why only temperature changes K, and how K controls the position of equilibrium.

concepts.title: Brønsted-Lowry acids and bases
concepts.scope: Acids as proton donors and bases as proton acceptors, conjugate pairs and the role of H+ in acid reactions.

concepts.title: pH, Kw and strong acids and bases
concepts.scope: Defining pH and Kw and calculating the pH of strong acids and strong bases.

concepts.title: Weak acids and Ka
concepts.scope: Ka and pKa, calculating the pH of weak acids, the approximations used and finding Ka from data.

concepts.title: pH titration curves and indicators
concepts.scope: Shapes of pH curves for strong and weak acids and bases, choosing indicators and reading Ka from a curve.

concepts.title: Buffer solutions
concepts.scope: How buffers resist pH change, how to make them, calculating their pH and the blood buffer.

concepts.title: Solubility product
concepts.scope: Ksp expressions and calculations, and the common ion effect.

concepts.title: Partition coefficient
concepts.scope: The partition coefficient Kpc between two solvents, its calculations and the factors that affect it.

concepts.title: Oxidation numbers and redox equations
concepts.scope: Oxidation number rules, oxidising and reducing agents, disproportionation and building redox equations from half-equations.

concepts.title: Redox titrations
concepts.scope: Manganate(VII) and iodine-thiosulfate titrations and the calculations based on them.

concepts.title: Electrode potentials and electrochemical cells
concepts.scope: Standard electrode potentials, the hydrogen electrode, measuring cell potentials, cell diagrams and the electrochemical series.

concepts.title: Predicting feasibility from electrode potentials
concepts.scope: Using Eᶿ values to predict redox reactions, link Ecell to ΔG and K, the Nernst equation for non-standard concentrations, and the limits of these predictions.

concepts.title: Storage cells and fuel cells
concepts.scope: Rechargeable and non-rechargeable cells and the hydrogen-oxygen fuel cell, with their benefits and risks.

concepts.title: Electrolysis and the Faraday constant
concepts.scope: Predicting electrolysis products and calculating masses and volumes liberated using the Faraday constant.

concepts.title: Periodicity across Periods 2 and 3
concepts.scope: The s, p and d blocks and periodic trends in radius, ionisation energy, melting point and conductivity.

concepts.title: Period 3 oxides and chlorides
concepts.scope: Reactions of Period 3 elements with oxygen, chlorine and water, and the acid-base behaviour of their oxides and chlorides.

concepts.title: Group 2
concepts.scope: Reactivity of Group 2 metals, their oxides and hydroxides, solubility trends and uses of their compounds.

concepts.title: Thermal stability and flame tests
concepts.scope: Thermal decomposition of Group 1 and 2 nitrates and carbonates, polarisation of the anion, and flame colours.

concepts.title: The halogens
concepts.scope: Physical properties of the halogens, their oxidising power and displacement reactions, and the hydrogen halides.

concepts.title: Halide ions
concepts.scope: Halides as reducing agents, their reactions with concentrated sulfuric acid, and the silver nitrate and ammonia test.

concepts.title: Chlorine, disproportionation and water treatment
concepts.scope: Chlorine reacting with water and sodium hydroxide, and the benefits and risks of chlorinating water.

concepts.title: Nitrogen and its compounds
concepts.scope: The unreactivity of nitrogen, ammonia and ammonium ions, and oxides of nitrogen in exhausts, smog and acid rain.

concepts.title: Tests for ions
concepts.scope: Test-tube tests for cations and anions such as carbonate, sulfate, halide and ammonium ions.

concepts.title: Transition elements and their properties
concepts.scope: Electron configurations of the d-block, what makes a transition element, and their typical properties.

concepts.title: Ligands and complex ions
concepts.scope: Ligands and dative bonds, coordination number, the shapes of complexes, their isomerism and cis-platin.

concepts.title: Coloured ions
concepts.scope: Why transition metal ions are coloured, d-orbital splitting, and what changes the colour.

concepts.title: Ligand substitution and stability constants
concepts.scope: Ligand exchange reactions and colour changes, the chelate effect, Kstab and haemoglobin.

concepts.title: Variable oxidation states
concepts.scope: Redox chemistry of vanadium, chromium, iron and copper ions and predicting it from electrode potentials.

concepts.title: Reactions of metal ions in aqueous solution
concepts.scope: Precipitation with sodium hydroxide and ammonia, amphoteric hydroxides and predicting unfamiliar reactions.

concepts.title: Transition metals as catalysts
concepts.scope: How heterogeneous and homogeneous transition metal catalysts work, including the contact process and autocatalysis.

concepts.title: Naming and formulae of organic compounds
concepts.scope: Homologous series, functional groups, the types of formula and IUPAC naming.

concepts.title: Reaction types and mechanisms
concepts.scope: Homolytic and heterolytic fission, radicals, nucleophiles and electrophiles, and drawing curly arrows.

concepts.title: Structural and E/Z isomerism
concepts.scope: Chain, position and functional group isomers and E/Z (cis-trans) stereoisomerism using CIP rules.

concepts.title: Alkanes, fuels and pollution
concepts.scope: Properties of alkanes, crude oil and cracking, combustion and the pollutants it makes and how they are removed.

concepts.title: Free-radical substitution
concepts.scope: The mechanism of free-radical substitution of alkanes by halogens and its limits in synthesis.

concepts.title: Alkenes and electrophilic addition
concepts.scope: Bonding in alkenes, their addition reactions, the electrophilic addition mechanism and Markovnikov's rule.

concepts.title: Addition polymers
concepts.scope: Forming addition polymers, repeat units and monomers, and dealing with waste polymers.

concepts.title: Halogenoalkanes and nucleophilic substitution
concepts.scope: Classifying halogenoalkanes, their reactions with nucleophiles, SN1 and SN2 mechanisms and rates of hydrolysis.

concepts.title: Elimination from halogenoalkanes
concepts.scope: Elimination with hot ethanolic hydroxide and how conditions decide between substitution and elimination.

concepts.title: Ozone depletion by CFCs
concepts.scope: How chlorine radicals from CFCs catalyse ozone breakdown and the move to safer alternatives.

concepts.title: Alcohols: production and properties
concepts.scope: Making alcohols by hydration and fermentation, classifying them and their physical properties and acidity.

concepts.title: Reactions of alcohols
concepts.scope: Oxidation, dehydration and substitution of alcohols, and the tri-iodomethane test.

concepts.title: Aldehydes and ketones
concepts.scope: Oxidation and reduction of carbonyls, nucleophilic addition of HCN and tests that distinguish aldehydes from ketones.

concepts.title: Carboxylic acids and esters
concepts.scope: Properties, preparation and reactions of carboxylic acids, relative acidities, and making and hydrolysing esters.

concepts.title: Acyl chlorides and acylation
concepts.scope: Making acyl chlorides and their addition-elimination reactions with water, alcohols, ammonia and amines.

concepts.title: Benzene and electrophilic substitution
concepts.scope: The delocalised model of benzene and the evidence for it, and nitration, halogenation and Friedel-Crafts mechanisms.

concepts.title: Phenols and directing effects
concepts.scope: The acidity and reactions of phenol, why it substitutes more easily than benzene, and directing effects of substituents.

concepts.title: Amines
concepts.scope: Making amines, their basicity and nucleophilic reactions, phenylamine and azo dyes.

concepts.title: Amides
concepts.scope: Forming amides from acyl chlorides, their hydrolysis and reduction, and why they are weak bases.

concepts.title: Amino acids, proteins and DNA
concepts.scope: Amino acids and zwitterions, peptide bonds and proteins, electrophoresis, enzymes, DNA and anticancer drugs.

concepts.title: Optical isomerism
concepts.scope: Chiral centres, enantiomers and plane-polarised light, racemic mixtures and chirality in drug synthesis.

concepts.title: Condensation polymers
concepts.scope: Polyesters and polyamides, their repeat units, hydrolysis and biodegradability compared with addition polymers.

concepts.title: Carbon-carbon bond formation and nitriles
concepts.scope: Lengthening carbon chains with cyanide, Grignard reagents and Friedel-Crafts reactions, and reactions of nitriles.

concepts.title: Organic synthesis routes
concepts.scope: Recognising functional groups, predicting reactions and planning multi-step synthetic routes.

concepts.title: Mass spectrometry of organic compounds
concepts.scope: Molecular ion peaks, fragmentation, M+1 and M+2 peaks and high-resolution mass spectrometry.

concepts.title: Infrared spectroscopy
concepts.scope: How bonds absorb infrared, identifying functional groups from IR spectra, and IR in global warming and breathalysers.

concepts.title: NMR spectroscopy
concepts.scope: Carbon-13 and proton NMR: environments, chemical shift, peak areas, splitting, TMS and deuterated solvents.

concepts.title: Chromatography
concepts.scope: TLC, Rf values, gas chromatography and HPLC, retention times and what affects separation.

concepts.title: Combined structure determination
concepts.scope: Deducing a structure by combining elemental analysis, mass, IR and NMR evidence.

concepts.title: Identifying organic and inorganic unknowns
concepts.scope: Test-tube tests for organic functional groups and identifying unknown substances.

concepts.title: Planning, risk and evaluating experiments
concepts.scope: Designing experiments, controlling variables and risk, and evaluating errors, uncertainties and improvements.

concepts.title: Recording and processing data
concepts.scope: Units, significant figures, presenting results and analysing data with graphs, gradients and intercepts.

concepts.title: Practical apparatus and techniques
concepts.scope: Using standard apparatus and techniques safely, from water baths and pH meters to chromatography and electrochemical cells.

concepts.title: Quantitative physical core practicals
concepts.scope: Core practicals measuring molar gas volume, titrations, enthalpy, Ka, cells, redox titrations, rates and activation energy.

concepts.title: Organic and inorganic preparations
concepts.scope: Preparing, purifying and testing organic liquids and solids and a transition metal complex, including reflux, distillation and recrystallisation.
